title: Unlock 'Touch and Share'! Tencent WorkBuddy Makes Its Debut on the HarmonyOS PC App Market
excerpt: On July 27, Zhang Jun, the public relations director of Tencent, announced that Tencent's office AI agent WorkBuddy has officially been launched on the HarmonyO
content_html:
On July 27, Zhang Jun, the public relations director of Tencent, announced that Tencent's office AI agent WorkBuddy has officially been launched on the HarmonyOS PC app market, becoming the first desktop office AI agent within the HarmonyOS ecosystem. According to the introduction, the team collaborated with HarmonyOS experts to overcome core scenarios such as system login, computer connection, skill invocation, and product preview, and quickly completed system-level permission adaptation.

Based on HarmonyOS's underlying capabilities, WorkBuddy also launched the "Touch & Share" feature, which is not yet available on other mainstream systems. As a desktop office tool with native AI capabilities, this AI agent has covered 17 industries, supports more than 140 AI applications, and 22,000 plugins. This launch on HarmonyOS PC not only demonstrates Tencent's determination in building an AI agent ecosystem, but also confirms the underlying strength of the HarmonyOS system in supporting complex AI applications, promoting the evolution of desktop office towards intelligent and seamless solutions.

content_html_zh:
7月27日，腾讯公关总监张军宣布，腾讯办公AI助手WorkBuddy正式登陆鸿蒙PC应用市场，成为鸿蒙生态内首个桌面办公AI助手。 据介绍，团队与鸿蒙专家协作攻克了系统登录、电脑连接、技能调用、产品预览等核心场景，快速完成了系统级权限适配。

基于HarmonyOS的底层能力，WorkBuddy还推出了“触摸分享”功能，这是其他主流系统尚不具备的。 作为一款原生AI能力的桌面办公工具，该AI代理已覆盖17个行业，支持140多个AI应用，22000个插件。 此次在HarmonyOS PC上的发布，不仅彰显了腾讯打造AI智能体生态的决心，也印证了HarmonyOS系统支持复杂AI应用的底层实力，推动桌面办公向智能化、无缝化的方向演进。
